title: SpaceBuildPublish
description: space.build-publish@1: what happened when a person's agent asked to publish one of their spaces (OpenVibe.Space's builder API; plan 2026-10-22 §Z stage Z1). POST /api/v1/spaces/:id/publish asks to publish and answers { state: 'pending' } with the approval the person answers in the Dock; it never publishes without that answer. When the person approves, Space publishes and the step is { state: 'published', url }; when they decline, { state: 'declined' }.

state.description: pending: the person must answer first. published: it is live at url. declined: the person said no.

url.description: Where it lives once it is published.

approval_id.description: The request the person answers in the Dock (its id).

reason.description: Why it was refused, in one line a person can act on.
